# Vite login port review

- Review the pinned template source, metadata, managed dependency closure and ownership before editing. If the release has substantive server-only requirements, a concrete gap plus compatible official layout composition is valid; falsely claiming the original block was installed is not.
- For an eligible port, inspect install output: only compatible managed items were installed through the supported installer. No fake Next dependency, metadata patch, manually copied managed implementation or fabricated install-state record.
- Compare project-owned port files to the preserved source: retain applicable `AuthLayout`, `Card`, `Field` and component styles. Record source hashes, framework import substitutions, consumer aliases and changed business fields.
- Typecheck/build without Next installed. Inspect POST `/api/session`: username/password names, validation, autocomplete and payload must remain correct; changing only the email label is a failure.
- Exercise empty fields, rejected credentials, pending/double submit, success and keyboard form submission using explicit fixtures. There must be no dead signup, social sign-in or legal links. Real backend coverage stays unchecked.
- Check final narrow/wide layout, focus and errors against the selected official structure. A new custom brand panel without a product constraint is not a template port.
- Shell, resources, route URLs and their styles remain unchanged except necessary shared integration whose impact is verified.
